decisions.reason: The two-component glass flake spraying system fits the firm's core spraying and coating equipment line and represents a sizable development investment, so management would attribute a slow start to normal ramp-up rather than drop it after one year, even though it is only mentioned on the website.

A dedicated web page signals visible public commitment to the low-pressure injection pump, and as a pump it sits close to the firm's core business, so escalation of commitment strongly favors keeping it.

The low-pressure material transfer pump has only a mention on the website, so the firm is less publicly committed to it, but it complements the pump portfolio and sunk costs make keeping it the likely choice.

A dedicated page shows public commitment to the fire protection flow monitoring product, and early weak results would be blamed on long certification and adoption cycles in fire protection, so management keeps it.
